_: THE DESK — the one page Mike opens. Pillars with their state, the instruments he uses, what he owes (read live from docs/HANDOFF_next_session.md), the reel line's week, the costs line. Ops keeps the pillar lines current; everything else is read from the tree at render. `npm run desk` writes docs/desk/DESK.html; the served copy is published from that file.
centre: Mike. Every pillar points here; the pillars are the tools.

pillars.name: The Record
pillars.sub: the story, told one entry a day
pillars.line: Five entries in the site for week one; week two's five unwritten.
pillars.next: Sunday: Record 001 lands; week two written by Fri 09-11.

pillars.name: Reach
pillars.sub: two reels a weekday, four surfaces
pillars.line: The Determination and the Number, through Buffer, the pop on every one.

pillars.name: Music
pillars.line: A live number a weekday from week two, one song at a time; Coconuts first; the record only for a song that catches.

pillars.name: Robots
pillars.line: The wing opens itself Monday at five; the daily determination is the spine from the day the machine is shown.

pillars.name: Foundation
pillars.line: A posture, no pipes: National Coalition for the Homeless.
pillars.next: After Sunday: repoint the link; your copy.

pillars.name: The Site
pillars.line: Live, stage launch, nothing waits on a deploy. The reel is the front door now; the site is the depth.

pillars.name: The System
pillars.line: Ops in Code; ledgers cut; calendar, reel line, cost ledger, this desk. Gates green.
pillars.next: Sunday: Never-Advertised reading; TikTok spec rewritten whole.
